gaps.note: The error kind alone is expressible, but the bad-input condition and the returns-rather-than-throws contrast are beyond the grammar
The cached flag alone is expressible, but the TTL window, the document-plus-parameters key, and the storage policy are beyond the grammar
Side-effect-free construction and first-use broker binding are lifecycle behaviour outside the grammar
Constructor rejections throw exceptions, which are outside the assertion grammar
The condition (schema violations present) and the composed error message are beyond the comparison grammar; the effect on kind alone would not distinguish this from other errors
Attaching the issue list as warnings conditions on validation results the grammar cannot reference
The per-document summary construction (shortname slicing, outcome keys, warnings) is structural mapping outside the grammar
value() returns the inner value of a value result; relating the two results is beyond the grammar
Refreshing sources and reporting per-source counts is a side-effecting aggregate outside the grammar
LensOutcomeError with the declared hint is a thrown exception, outside the assertion grammar
LensResultError carrying message and issues is a thrown exception, outside the assertion grammar
